title: instantiate_template specification
description: specification payload for action=instantiate_template (ADR-0008). Owned by WS-15; frozen shape accepted by WS-01 from RB-10.

template_id.description: Canonical template id, including version suffix when applicable (e.g. niagara.projectile.elemental.v1).

inputs.description: Values for the template's declared inputs (e.g. element: fire|water|wind|earth). Additional properties allowed — validated against the template's inputs schema at runtime.

modifiers.description: Named modifier grammar from RB-10. Unknown modifier names fail closed.

add.description: Named additive modifiers (extra debris, trails, etc.).
